:::{#def-even-odd}
#### Even integer

An integer (@def-integers) $n$ is **even**
[@wikipedia_parity_mathematics]
if $n = 2k$ for some integer $k$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-odd}
#### Odd integer

An integer (@def-integers) $n$ is **odd**
[@wikipedia_parity_mathematics]
if $n = 2k + 1$ for some integer $k$.

:::
